captions.caption: Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a pale lobulated protruding lesion arising from a blue-stained elevated mucosal cushion, showing smooth surface texture, distinct margins, and surrounding pink to orange colonic mucosa with reflective fluid highlights; no active bleeding or instrument tip is clearly visible.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a lobulated raised mucosal lesion highlighted by blue dye, showing a pale bluish surface and distinct borders. Surrounding colonic folds are stained blue-green, with a visible submucosal lift, glossy mucus, and no active bleeding clearly seen.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a prominent elevated lobulated mucosal mound stained blue, showing irregular but distinct margins and a textured surface pattern. Surrounding mucosa appears brown-pink, with curved folds, a partially visible lumen, and small reflective mucus or fluid highlights.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a large multilobulated, elevated lesion showing pale pink to whitish mucosa and patchy blue dye staining. The surface appears nodular and granular with broad rounded lobules, scattered yellow mucus or debris, and a dark surrounding lumen.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a rounded pale blue elevated lesion arising from stained surrounding mucosa, showing smooth to slightly nodular surface texture and distinct margins. Blue dye pools around the base, while adjacent pink colonic folds and a dark lumen are visible without active bleeding.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a broad smooth elevated lesion in the colonic lumen, showing pale whitish mucosa covered by blue dye. The margins are accentuated by staining, with mild surface speckling and a small adjacent reddish area, while surrounding folds appear pink and smooth.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a prominent blue-stained elevated mucosal mound in the foreground, showing smooth glossy surface texture and a rounded contour. Adjacent mucosa is pink to red with visible folds, while the stained surrounding area appears broadly demarcated without active bleeding.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a round, well-circumscribed pale elevated lesion centered on blue-stained mucosa. The surrounding surface appears smooth and fluid coated, with mild glare from illumination, gentle fold curvature at the margin, and no clear active bleeding or adherent debris visible.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a pale blue, smoothly elevated lobulated lesion protruding into the lumen beside a dark blue stained mucosal area. Surrounding mucosa appears pink and glossy with visible folds, and the lesion margins are distinct without obvious active bleeding.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a lobulated pale pink elevated mass in the foreground, outlined by blue-green dye on surrounding mucosa. The surface appears nodular and bulbous with shallow grooves, and there is focal fresh red bleeding near the center against a dark colonic lumen.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a large multilobulated pale pink elevated lesion, smooth glossy surface, and visible submucosal lifting. Patchy yellow dye stains the crest and sides, while surrounding mucosa appears tan with a partially seen dark lumen and small adherent mucus reflections.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a rounded blue-stained protruding lesion in the foreground, showing smooth glossy surface and clear elevation from surrounding mucosa. Adjacent folds are coated with blue dye, while the background mucosa appears pink, gently textured, and the central lumen remains visible.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a clustered lobulated pale elevated lesion projecting into the lumen, surrounded by blue-stained mucosa. The polyp surface appears smooth to slightly nodular with distinct margins, while the adjacent colonic wall shows preserved folds and no obvious active bleeding.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a large pale blue elevated lesion showing lobulated surface texture and visible submucosal vessels, surrounded by darker blue staining at the margin. Adjacent mucosa appears pink to tan with smooth folds, and specular highlights reflect a moist surface.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with blue staining outlining elevated pale nodular mucosa in the lower field, showing a lobulated protruding surface and a small focal red erosion or bleed near the crest. Surrounding mucosa is pink with visible folds and a curved luminal wall.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a rounded, prominently elevated lesion in the foreground, coated in blue staining and scattered pale yellow mucus or debris. Surrounding mucosa appears smooth and glistening, with thickened folds and a partially visible dark lumen in the background.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a rounded elevated lesion in the foreground, showing blue dye staining over pale nodular mucosa and distinct lifted margins. The surface appears irregular and lobulated, with small yellowish areas and a glossy mucus-coated background lumen.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a blue-stained elevated mucosal area and adjacent pale lobulated protruding tissue. Surrounding mucosa appears pink-brown with smooth folds, while the lesion margins are accentuated by dye.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a centrally raised pale nodular lesion surrounded by blue-green staining and lifted mucosa. The surface appears smooth and lobulated, with clear contrast against orange-pink surrounding folds, mild glare from fluid, and no active bleeding clearly visible.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a round, prominently elevated lesion in the right foreground, coated by blue dye and smooth glossy mucosa. Surrounding folds show mixed pale pink and bluish staining, with visible submucosal lift, clear borders, and small reflective mucus droplets.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a prominent smooth pink elevated lesion arising from blue-stained surrounding mucosa, showing a lobulated surface pattern and well-defined margins. Small red focal erosion is visible on the side, with glossy mucus and adjacent colonic folds partially framing the lumen.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a prominent pale nodular protrusion arising from a broad blue-stained elevated cushion, showing smooth lobulated surface, distinct margins against surrounding pink mucosa, visible submucosal vascular pattern through the dye, and mild surface mucus without active bleeding.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a large smooth rounded protruding lesion in the right foreground, coated in pale blue dye. Surrounding mucosa is pink to orange with visible fine vascular pattern and folds, and the lesion margins appear distinct against the stained base.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a prominently elevated bluish stained mucosal mound occupying the foreground, showing a lobulated uneven surface, a small focal red area suggestive of minor bleeding, and surrounding brown colonic folds with a partially visible lumen in the background.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with blue staining outlining an elevated lobulated lesion along the right wall, showing smooth pale pink to gray mucosa and distinct margins. Surrounding colonic folds curve around a central lumen, with mild surface mucus and no active bleeding visible.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a large rounded blue-stained elevated lesion occupying most of the view, showing a smooth slightly lobulated surface, broad base, and distinct contour. Surrounding mucosa appears pink to tan, with specular glare and no clear active bleeding or visible instrument.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a lobulated elevated lesion centered in a blue-stained submucosal lift, showing pale whitish nodular surfaces and small yellowish mucus or debris on top. Surrounding mucosa appears pink to red with visible folds, glossy fluid, and a well-demarcated lifted field.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a large smooth blue-stained protruding lesion occupying much of the lumen, showing a rounded elevated contour and distinct margins. Surrounding mucosa appears pink with concentric folds, while the lesion surface looks glossy and uniformly dyed without obvious bleeding.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a smooth, rounded pale blue elevated lesion arising from the colonic mucosa, sharply outlined by blue dye. Surrounding mucosa appears pink and glistening with gentle folds and a dark lumen, without visible bleeding, debris, or instrument contact.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a large smooth dome-shaped elevated lesion, diffusely blue stained after submucosal lift. The surface appears pale and slightly granular with glossy mucus and light reflections, while the surrounding mucosa is also dye coated and the lesion margins remain broadly distinct.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a large dome-shaped, blue-stained elevated lesion projecting into the lumen, showing a smooth yet slightly lobulated surface with visible vascular pattern. Yellow dye pools along the lower margin, and surrounding mucosa appears pink and glistening.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a large smooth elevated lesion in the foreground, coated by blue dye over pale mucosa. The surface appears glossy and lobulated with clear protrusion, while the surrounding colonic folds and central lumen are visible in the background.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a prominently elevated, blue-stained mucosal lesion on the right side, showing smooth glossy surface and clear contour. Surrounding mucosa appears pink to tan with visible vascular pattern, converging folds, and a small darker stained area nearby.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with two rounded blue-stained elevated nodules in the lower field, showing smooth glossy surfaces and clear protrusion from surrounding pink colonic mucosa. Adjacent folds curve around a partially visible lumen, with scattered mucus bubbles and no obvious active bleeding.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a rounded elevated lesion in the colonic lumen, coated by blue dye over a pale central surface. Surrounding mucosa is pink to orange with smooth folds, glossy fluid, and a distinct lifted margin around the stained polyp.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a prominent pale lobulated protrusion arising from blue-stained surrounding mucosa, showing smooth glossy surface, broad base, and clear elevation into the lumen. Adjacent colonic wall appears pink-brown with visible folds, without obvious bleeding or debris.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a prominent blue-stained, elevated lobulated lesion projecting into the lumen, showing a smooth glossy surface and a pale yellow central area. Surrounding mucosa appears pink-brown with visible vascular pattern, and no active bleeding is clearly visible.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a prominent raised lobulated lesion, showing blue dye staining over surrounding mucosa and pale pink to reddish nodular surfaces. The lesion appears smoothly elevated with distinct borders, visible submucosal lift, and glossy reflections without clear active bleeding.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a prominent elongated raised lesion in blue-stained mucosa, showing a smooth lobulated surface and distinct margins. Surrounding folds appear diffusely tinted with mild sheen and fluid, while the lumen is not clearly visible and no active bleeding is seen.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a large rounded elevated lesion coated in blue-gray stain, showing a smooth glossy surface and distinct margins. Surrounding mucosa appears pink to salmon colored with prominent folds, a narrowed lumen, and small reflective mucus or fluid droplets nearby.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a large lobulated pale pink protruding lesion elevated from blue-stained mucosa, showing smooth glossy surface, scattered erythematous erosions, and distinct margins. Surrounding folds are tinted blue, with a small patch of adherent debris visible inferiorly.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a rounded elevated lesion outlined by blue dye, showing pale nodular lobules on the surface. Surrounding mucosa is orange-pink and glossy, with visible lift effect, clear margins, small dark specks, and mild adherent fluid or mucus.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a large pale blue elevated lobulated mucosal area, showing prominent surface folds and a broad smooth contour. The lesion has distinct stained margins against adjacent pink mucosa, with slight mucus sheen and no obvious active bleeding visible.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a small rounded pale protrusion arising from blue-stained mucosa near the colonic fold, showing smooth glossy surface, distinct elevation, and a dark central lumen below; surrounding mucosa appears pink to reddish with preserved curved folds.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a broad, smooth mucosal elevation showing pale pink to reddish surface tones, surrounded by blue dye staining. The lesion appears gently raised with soft margins, glossy mucus reflections, and curved colonic folds partially enclosing the view.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a prominent pale rounded elevated lesion arising from blue-stained surrounding mucosa, showing a smooth glossy surface and clear protrusion. Adjacent pink colonic folds and a partial dark lumen are visible, with small debris near the lower field.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a pale elevated mucosal area in the lower field, coated by whitish mucus or exudate and bordered by blue dye staining. Surrounding mucosa appears smooth and pink-orange with visible folds and a dark oval lumen opening in the upper right.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with blue-stained surrounding mucosa and a centrally elevated, irregular brownish polypoid area. The lesion shows a granular surface with distinct lifted margins, patchy dark debris or coagulum, and glossy mucus reflecting light within the colonic lumen.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a pale lobulated protruding lesion arising from blue-stained elevated mucosa on the left wall, showing distinct margins and smooth surface texture. The adjacent colonic lumen and concentric brown mucosal folds are visible, with mild reflective mucus and no obvious active bleeding.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a large lobulated elevated lesion coated by blue-white dye, showing irregular nodular surface texture and pale pink mucosa. Focal red exposed areas and slight surface oozing are visible, with surrounding colonic lumen partly seen at the edge.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a broad, lobulated elevated lesion showing pale pink to tan mucosa and irregular nodular surface pattern. Margins appear distinct against the surrounding stained mucosa, with glistening mucus and scattered bright specular highlights under narrow-band imaging.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a lobulated pale elevated lesion at the upper right, surrounded by blue staining from submucosal lift. Adjacent mucosa appears pink to reddish with smooth glossy folds, distinct lesion margins, and no clear active bleeding or adherent debris.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a large rounded mucosal elevation in the foreground, coated by blue dye and showing a pale central area. Surrounding colonic mucosa appears pink to reddish with smooth folds, glossy surface reflections, and a visible lumen in the background.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with pale elevated nodular lesions on blue-stained mucosa, showing a smooth to slightly granular surface and scattered reddish speckles. The surrounding mucosal folds are pink and glossy, with a curved lumen edge visible and small reflective mucus droplets present.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a pale gray elevated lesion in the lower field, showing dark dye streaks and a small central reddish spot. Surrounding mucosa is pink and glossy with visible folds, while clustered bubbles and mucus line the right side.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a lobulated pale pink protruding lesion in the lower right colon wall, surrounded by extensive blue submucosal staining and lifted mucosa. The surface appears smooth and glossy, with clear elevation, adjacent folds, and a small amount of fluid or mucus debris.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a clustered lobulated mucosal elevation in the foreground, heavily stained blue-green, showing a pale nodular surface and distinct lifted margins. Surrounding colonic folds are pink-brown, with small reflective mucus droplets and no active bleeding clearly visible.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with lobulated pale nodular mucosa prominently stained blue, forming a raised clustered lesion with smooth bulbous surfaces. Surrounding folds are also blue-tinted and swollen, while adjacent brown mucosa remains visible, with mild surface mucus and no clear bleeding.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a rounded elevated lesion grasped or contacted by an instrument, surrounded by blue staining on pink colonic mucosa. The lumen is open with curved folds, and the stained area has distinct margins with mild surface mucus and no active bleeding visible.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a large raised lobulated lesion coated in blue dye, showing a smooth slightly nodular surface and clear elevation from surrounding pink-brown mucosa. Small yellowish mucus or exudate spots are present, with the adjacent lumen and folds partly visible.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a pale lobulated protruding lesion grasped by an instrument, arising from blue stained lifted mucosa. The surface appears granular and slightly nodular, with clear elevation above surrounding pink to orange colonic folds and a visible central lumen in the background.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a broad, elevated mucosal area stained blue, showing irregular granular surface texture and surrounding pale pink folds. Small superficial blood spots are visible along the margin, and the lesion boundaries appear partly defined by the dye contrast.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a prominent pale nodular protrusion arising from blue-stained elevated mucosa, showing a smooth to slightly lobulated surface and distinct margins. Surrounding colonic folds curve around a dark lumen, with glossy fluid reflections and small bubbles visible nearby.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with broad blue-stained elevated mucosa occupying the lower field, showing a smooth glistening surface and rounded lifted contour. Surrounding mucosa is pink to orange with gentle folds curving toward a dark central lumen, and no active bleeding is clearly visible.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a broad, lobulated pale elevated lesion surrounded by blue dye staining. The surface appears nodular and slightly cerebriform with smooth rounded contours, distinct margins, and adjacent mucosal folds converging around the lifted polyp; no active bleeding is clearly visible.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with clustered lobulated pale pink nodules elevated from blue-stained mucosa, forming an irregular cauliflower-like surface. Central shallow erosion with slight red discoloration is visible, while surrounding folds are obscured by the bulky lifted lesion and scattered mucus reflections.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a small sessile, smoothly elevated lesion on a colonic fold, showing pale pink to whitish surface contrast against surrounding stained mucosa. The margins appear distinct, with glistening mucus and preserved nearby folds and lumen.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a large pale whitish lobulated protruding lesion arising from blue-stained surrounding mucosa, showing a smooth glossy surface with visible vascular pattern, distinct margins, and slight focal redness near the base; no instrument or active bleeding is clearly visible.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a round pale protruding nodule arising from a broad blue-stained elevated mound, showing smooth surface texture and clear lifting margins. Surrounding mucosa appears pink to orange with visible folds, while the central lesion is well circumscribed and nonbleeding.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a broad, elevated mucosal lesion in the foreground, heavily stained blue-green and showing a smooth to slightly lobulated surface. The surrounding colonic mucosa is pink-brown with visible folds and a central lumen, while specular highlights and a small darker stained spot are present.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a pale nodular protruding lesion arising from blue-stained mucosa, showing a granular irregular surface and distinct elevation above the surrounding wall. Colonic folds curve in the background, with mild mucus and no active bleeding clearly visible.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a smooth rounded elevated lesion showing pale yellow tan mucosa and fine speckled pit pattern, surrounded by blue dye and a lifted submucosal cushion; margins are well delineated against pink colonic folds with a small amount of surface mucus.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a large smooth dome-shaped blue-stained protrusion arising from pale pink colonic mucosa, showing a well-defined elevated contour, glossy surface reflections, surrounding blue dye pooling, visible submucosal lift effect, and small adherent bubbles or mucus nearby.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a pale elevated round lesion centered on blue-stained mucosa, showing smooth surface texture and distinct margins. Surrounding colonic folds are pink and glistening, with a small adjacent dark opening and mild mucus or fluid reflection, without obvious bleeding.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a rounded pale nodular lesion elevated on a prominent blue-stained submucosal lift, showing smooth glossy surface and distinct margins. Surrounding mucosa appears pink-orange, with colonic folds partly visible and no active bleeding or debris clearly seen.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a centrally elevated, blue-stained mucosal area showing lobulated contours and distinct margins against surrounding pink-orange mucosa.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with intense blue staining over surrounding mucosa and a small lobulated protruding lesion on the right, showing smooth glossy surface, distinct borders, and lifted submucosal cushion appearance; endoscopic accessory preview is visible in the corner.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a pale, lobulated elevated lesion centered in a broad blue-stained mucosal field, showing smooth granular surface texture, distinct margins, mild focal redness on one side, and surrounding glossy mucosa without clear active bleeding or adherent debris.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a centrally elevated pale nodular lesion surrounded by blue-stained mucosa, showing smooth swollen surface contours, subtle peripheral discoloration, and a shallow luminal background with gentle folds.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with multiple lobulated pale mucosal elevations in the foreground, coated by blue dye that highlights the lifted surface and shallow grooves. The surrounding colonic mucosa appears pink-gray with visible folds and a central lumen, without active bleeding.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a large lobulated pink polypoid mass elevated above blue stained mucosa, showing a smooth slightly granular surface, broad base, and distinct margins. Surrounding folds are flattened by lifting, with small reflective mucus droplets and no active bleeding visible.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with broad elevated mucosa coated in blue dye, showing a smooth to slightly lobulated surface and glistening highlights. The lesion has fairly distinct margins, with surrounding pink colonic folds and a partially visible lumen along the left side.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with two lobulated pale pink elevated lesions arising from colonic mucosa, surrounded by blue staining from submucosal lift. The surfaces appear irregular and nodular with glossy mucus, distinct margins, and a small area of dark debris or minor bleeding near the base.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a prominent elongated mucosal elevation coated in blue dye along the right wall, showing smooth glossy surface, distinct margins, and a lifted appearance. Surrounding mucosa is pink-brown with visible folds and a narrow central lumen, without obvious active bleeding.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a large smooth rounded mucosal elevation coated in blue dye, showing subtle surface vascular pattern and clear protrusion into the lumen. Surrounding mucosa appears pale and folded, with glossy reflections and no obvious active bleeding or debris visible.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a pale multilobulated raised lesion emerging from blue stained mucosa, showing a smooth slightly nodular surface and distinct lifted margins. Surrounding mucosa appears orange pink at the edge, with scattered dark specks and mild surface debris.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a large rounded mucosal elevation stained blue-green, showing a smooth slightly lobulated surface and distinct margins. Surrounding colonic folds are tan-pink with glossy mucus, and the lifted submucosal cushion is visible without active bleeding or instrument view.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a large lobulated pale lesion elevated from the surrounding mucosa, broadly coated in blue dye. The surface appears smooth and nodular with shallow linear creases, while adjacent brown mucosal folds and the dark lumen remain visible in the background.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a smooth, prominently elevated blue-stained mucosal mound on the right wall, showing clear borders and glossy surface reflections. Surrounding mucosa is pink to reddish with visible folds and lumen, and a small pale area is seen on the lesion surface.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a large lobulated elevated lesion coated in blue-green dye, showing irregular nodular surface texture and pale whitish areas. The margins appear distinct against surrounding pink colonic mucosa, with broad fold distortion and a partially seen adjacent lumen.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a small rounded pale protrusion arising from blue-stained colonic mucosa, showing distinct lifted submucosal elevation along a fold.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a broad, elevated lesion in the distal lumen, covered by blue dye and showing a pale lobulated surface with distinct pit pattern. Surrounding mucosa is pink with visible vascular markings, and the polyp margins appear well delineated against the stained base.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a pale lobulated elevated lesion in the foreground, surrounded by blue staining and a smoothly raised submucosal cushion. The adjacent colonic mucosa appears pink-orange with visible folds and an open lumen, without obvious active bleeding or instrument tip.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a broad, elevated lesion stained blue, showing a smooth glossy surface and distinct margins. A small paler nodular focus is visible on the right side, with surrounding colonic folds, mild mucus sheen, and an instrument entering from the lower left.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a large pale pink to whitish pedunculated protrusion, its stalk and base coated in blue dye. The surface appears smooth and glossy with faint branching vessels, while surrounding mucosa is tan and curved around a narrowed lumen.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a small smooth pale polypoid protrusion at the right edge, surrounded by intense blue staining and lifted mucosa. Adjacent mucosa appears pink to orange with visible vascular pattern and gentle folds, while the lesion surface looks glossy and well demarcated.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a blue-stained elevated mucosal area occupying the right side, containing several smooth nodular protrusions with distinct margins. Surrounding mucosa is pink to orange with visible folds, while the lesion surface appears glossy and slightly uneven without obvious bleeding.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a lobulated pale elevated lesion in the center, surrounded by blue stained mucosa and thickened folds. The surface appears nodular and irregular, with distinct lifted margins, mild central redness, and a small amount of adherent mucus.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a round elevated lesion projecting into the lumen, its surface pale pink to cream and smooth with faint vascular markings. Surrounding mucosa shows blue dye staining along the fold, glossy secretions, and a clearly demarcated lifted contour.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a prominent pale pink pedunculated protrusion arising from blue-stained lifted mucosa, showing a smooth lobulated surface and clear margin. Surrounding colonic folds and a dark lumen are visible, with mild mucus sheen and no active bleeding clearly seen.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with broad elevated mucosa stained blue, showing a slightly nodular surface and clear lifting from surrounding pale pink tissue. A circular instrument tip contacts the lesion, with small dark debris and minimal focal bleeding near the center.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a small pale nodular protrusion centered in a broad blue-stained lifted mucosal area, showing smooth glossy surface, distinct margins against surrounding pink folded mucosa, scattered light reflections, and a nearby dark lumen opening without visible active bleeding.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a prominent rounded pale lesion bulging from blue stained mucosa, showing smooth glossy surface and clear elevation. Surrounding folds are diffusely tinted blue with mild mucus or fluid sheen, and the adjacent dark lumen is visible in the background.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a round pale nodular lesion elevated on a blue-stained submucosal cushion, showing clear margins and smooth surface texture. Surrounding mucosa appears pink-orange with gentle folds, scattered reflective mucus, and another smaller protruding polypoid area near the lower left.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a large elevated pale nodular lesion in the foreground, coated by blue dye and patchy white exudative surface. The polyp has lobulated contours with a smaller protruding nodule, while surrounding colonic folds and lumen show brown mucosa with pooled blue staining.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a broad elevated pale lesion centered in blue-stained mucosa, showing a lobulated granular surface and distinct margins. Small focal red spots are visible on the lesion, while surrounding folds appear smooth with patchy dye pooling and mild reflective mucus.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a small rounded elevated lesion in the lower field, showing pale pink to gray surface tones over blue-stained surrounding mucosa. The polyp appears smoothly contoured with distinct margins, mild surface shine, and no active bleeding clearly visible.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a clustered, lobulated elevated lesion in the lower right, heavily stained blue with glossy mucus and bright reflections. The surrounding mucosa is pink to tan with visible vascular pattern, and the lesion shows distinct lifted borders against adjacent folds.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a centrally elevated pale nodular focus surrounded by broad blue staining on smooth colonic mucosa. The lifted area appears well demarcated, with gentle mucosal folds at the margin, mild surface glare, and no obvious bleeding or adherent debris visible.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a broad, elevated mucosal mound stained blue, showing smooth glossy surface contours and a pale central prominence. Surrounding colonic folds curve around the lesion, with distinct dye pooling, mild mucus sheen, and no active bleeding clearly visible.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a round, smoothly elevated pale lesion emerging from blue-stained surrounding mucosa. The surface appears glossy and slightly lobulated, with clear margins and a lifted submucosal cushion.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with multiple pale lobulated mucosal nodules in the foreground, their surfaces appearing swollen and lifted after dye injection. Blue-green staining outlines the surrounding mucosa, while yellow mucus or debris overlies the central lesion and the dark colonic lumen opens behind.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a lobulated pale pink elevated lesion arising from blue stained mucosa, showing a smooth glossy surface and distinct contours. Surrounding folds appear flattened by lifting, with visible dye pooling nearby and no active bleeding or instrument seen.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a rounded brown protruding lesion arising from bluish dyed colonic mucosa, showing a smooth glossy surface and distinct margins. Surrounding folds appear edematous and stained, with small yellow mucus or debris adherent nearby and a dark central lumen in view.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a lobulated pale elevated lesion arising from blue-stained mucosa, showing a granular surface and distinct contour. Surrounding folds are lightly tinted blue, with a small adjacent fluid pool and mild reflective mucus, while no active bleeding is clearly visible.

Confirmed diagnostic category: dyed lifted polyps. Dyed and lifted polyp with a large pale blue-stained elevated mucosal mound occupying the left side, showing smooth glossy surface, subtle irregular vascular markings, and small yellow debris near the base; surrounding mucosa is pink with a curved luminal fold on the right.
